report.scoping: This report covers all covered markets for August 2026. It is drawn from 141 projects and 126 captured records. Of those projects, 15 are described in full, selected by significance; 39 further projects are counted but not described; 58 projects filed nothing in this period; and 29 carry no market or region we could resolve. 2 projects whose every record has been dismissed are excluded entirely, because they have no filing to cite. A further 32 projects in this geography are excluded because our capture holds no published name for them; the coverage note says where. 6 projects in Miami-Dade County and San Antonio are held out entirely: the public source we read for those markets has stopped publishing, so what we hold is historical. The coverage note gives the dates. Anything outside that geography or period is not covered here.
